records.context: Attempt automatic API reporting without opening a browser.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.file_without_review#0
records.source: Attempt automatic API reporting without opening a browser.
records.translation: 브라우저를 열지 않고 API를 통한 자동 보고를 시도합니다.

records.context: Runs synchronously on the calling thread: resolving a token can run ``gh auth token``, and GitHub API calls can block while waiting for responses. Callers choose where to run it.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.file_without_review#1
records.source: Runs synchronously on the calling thread: resolving a token can run ``gh auth token``, and GitHub API calls can block while waiting for responses. Callers choose where to run it.
records.translation: 호출 스레드에서 동기적으로 실행됩니다. 토큰을 확인하는 과정에서 ``gh auth token``을 실행할 수 있으며, GitHub API 호출은 응답을 기다리는 동안 실행을 차단할 수 있습니다. 호출자가 실행 위치를 선택합니다.

records.context: This helper is used for issue reporting set to 'always', but does not enforce that setting. A transport refusal produces :data:`REFUSED`, and no available token produces :data:`SIGNED_OUT`. Otherwise attempt an API post or a comment on an existing issue; no browser form is opened.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.file_without_review#2
records.source: This helper is used for issue reporting set to 'always', but does not enforce that setting. A transport refusal produces :data:`REFUSED`, and no available token produces :data:`SIGNED_OUT`. Otherwise attempt an API post or a comment on an existing issue; no browser form is opened.
records.translation: 이 보조 함수는 이슈 보고 설정이 'always'일 때 사용되지만, 해당 설정을 강제하지는 않습니다. 전송 거부 시 :data:`REFUSED`를, 사용 가능한 토큰이 없으면 :data:`SIGNED_OUT`을 생성합니다. 그 외에는 API 제출 또는 기존 이슈에 대한 댓글 작성을 시도하며, 브라우저 양식은 열지 않습니다.

records.context: A mapping with ``status`` and optional ``url`` or ``detail`` fields. Status is :data:`FILED`, :data:`SEEN_AGAIN` (a successful comment on an existing issue with the same fingerprint), :data:`SIGNED_OUT`, :data:`REFUSED` or :data:`FAILED`. Caught :class:`Exception` instances are converted to :data:`FAILED` with an exception description.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.file_without_review#4
records.source: A mapping with ``status`` and optional ``url`` or ``detail`` fields. Status is :data:`FILED`, :data:`SEEN_AGAIN` (a successful comment on an existing issue with the same fingerprint), :data:`SIGNED_OUT`, :data:`REFUSED` or :data:`FAILED`. Caught :class:`Exception` instances are converted to :data:`FAILED` with an exception description.
records.translation: ``status``와 선택적 ``url`` 또는 ``detail`` 필드를 포함하는 매핑입니다. 상태는 :data:`FILED`, :data:`SEEN_AGAIN`(같은 지문을 가진 기존 이슈에 댓글을 성공적으로 작성함), :data:`SIGNED_OUT`, :data:`REFUSED`, :data:`FAILED` 중 하나입니다. 포착된 :class:`Exception` 인스턴스는 예외 설명이 포함된 :data:`FAILED`로 변환됩니다.

records.context: Where a report's log copy is written.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.log_bundle_dir#0
records.source: Where a report's log copy is written.
records.translation: 보고서의 로그 복사본을 저장하는 위치입니다.

records.context: Prepare the path-stripped title and body of a report.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.public_report#0
records.source: Prepare the path-stripped title and body of a report.
records.translation: 보고서의 제목과 본문에서 경로를 제거한 형태를 준비합니다.

records.context: The preview defaults to removing file and folder names, and automatic reporting uses this helper to prepare that form. Apply :func:`strip_report_paths` to the title and body after converting their values to strings; copy the fingerprint as a string. Missing fields default to empty strings, and other fields are omitted. This helper does not send the report or check user approval.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.public_report#1
records.source: The preview defaults to removing file and folder names, and automatic reporting uses this helper to prepare that form. Apply :func:`strip_report_paths` to the title and body after converting their values to strings; copy the fingerprint as a string. Missing fields default to empty strings, and other fields are omitted. This helper does not send the report or check user approval.
records.translation: 미리 보기는 기본적으로 파일과 폴더 이름을 제거하며, 자동 보고는 이 보조 함수로 해당 형식을 준비합니다. :func:`strip_report_paths`를 제목과 본문에 적용하되 값을 먼저 문자열로 변환하고, 지문도 문자열로 복사합니다. 누락된 필드의 기본값은 빈 문자열이며 다른 필드는 제외됩니다. 이 보조 함수는 보고서를 보내거나 사용자 승인을 확인하지 않습니다.

records.context: A new mapping containing the string fields ``title``, ``body`` and ``fingerprint``. Path removal is limited to the patterns supported by :func:`strip_report_paths`.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.public_report#3
records.source: A new mapping containing the string fields ``title``, ``body`` and ``fingerprint``. Path removal is limited to the patterns supported by :func:`strip_report_paths`.
records.translation: 문자열 필드 ``title``, ``body``, ``fingerprint``를 포함하는 새 매핑입니다. 경로 제거는 :func:`strip_report_paths`에서 지원하는 패턴으로 제한됩니다.

records.context: Sanitise a full traceback string via :func:`sanitize_path`.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.sanitize_traceback#0
records.source: Sanitise a full traceback string via :func:`sanitize_path`.
records.translation: 전체 트레이스백 문자열을 :func:`sanitize_path`로 정리합니다.

records.context: Replace recognized path-like text in an already sanitised report.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#0
records.source: Replace recognized path-like text in an already sanitised report.
records.translation: 이미 정리된 보고서에서 경로 형태로 인식되는 텍스트를 바꿉니다.

records.context: The ordinary sanitizer abbreviates the home directory so a traceback is still useful. This helper then applies patterns for traceback file fields, quoted path values and remaining absolute path-like tokens, replacing recognized paths with ``<PATH>``. Callers use it for the stricter public-report form; it does not call :func:`sanitize_path`, display a preview or send a report. Unrecognized names can remain.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#1
records.source: The ordinary sanitizer abbreviates the home directory so a traceback is still useful. This helper then applies patterns for traceback file fields, quoted path values and remaining absolute path-like tokens, replacing recognized paths with ``<PATH>``. Callers use it for the stricter public-report form; it does not call :func:`sanitize_path`, display a preview or send a report. Unrecognized names can remain.
records.translation: 일반 정리 함수는 추적 정보를 유용하게 유지하도록 홈 디렉터리를 줄여 표시합니다. 이 보조 함수는 이어서 추적 정보의 파일 필드, 따옴표로 묶인 경로 값, 나머지 절대 경로 형태의 토큰에 패턴을 적용하여 인식된 경로를 ``<PATH>``로 바꿉니다. 호출자는 더 엄격한 공개 보고서 형식을 위해 이를 사용합니다. 이 함수는 :func:`sanitize_path`를 호출하거나 미리 보기를 표시하거나 보고서를 보내지 않습니다. 인식되지 않은 이름은 남을 수 있습니다.

records.context: A path can contain a space, and a rule that stops a path at the first whitespace publishes the rest of it. ``/Volumes/Lab Drive/Patient 042`` came out as ``<PATH> Drive/Patient 042``, and ``C:\Users\anna\OneDrive - Karolinska Institutet\Screens`` kept the institution and the screen — the two operating systems whose own folders have spaces in them. A UNC path was not a path at all: nothing here started at ``\\``. The LAST component of an unquoted path has no separator after it to prove a space is inside the path rather than after it, so it executes on only over words shaped like a name -- a number, a capitalised word, a file name -- and ``\\LAB-NAS\screens\plate 1`` is replaced whole while ``opening /mnt/data/x.tif failed`` keeps its ``failed``. A lower-case word ending such a component still survives it; a quoted path is taken whole, and the title and every ``repr``-ed settings value are quoted.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#2
records.source: A path can contain a space, and a rule that stops a path at the first whitespace publishes the rest of it. ``/Volumes/Lab Drive/Patient 042`` came out as ``<PATH> Drive/Patient 042``, and ``C:\Users\anna\OneDrive - Karolinska Institutet\Screens`` kept the institution and the screen — the two operating systems whose own folders have spaces in them. A UNC path was not a path at all: nothing here started at ``\\``. The LAST component of an unquoted path has no separator after it to prove a space is inside the path rather than after it, so it runs on only over words shaped like a name -- a number, a capitalised word, a file name -- and ``\\LAB-NAS\screens\plate 1`` is replaced whole while ``opening /mnt/data/x.tif failed`` keeps its ``failed``. A lower-case word ending such a component still survives it; a quoted path is taken whole, and the title and every ``repr``-ed settings value are quoted.
records.translation: 경로에는 공백이 포함될 수 있으며, 첫 공백에서 경로를 끊는 규칙은 나머지 부분을 공개합니다. ``/Volumes/Lab Drive/Patient 042``는 ``<PATH> Drive/Patient 042``로 바뀌었고, ``C:\Users\anna\OneDrive - Karolinska Institutet\Screens``에서는 기관과 Screens 폴더 이름이 남았습니다. 이 두 운영 체제는 자체 폴더 이름에도 공백을 사용합니다. UNC 경로는 경로로조차 인식되지 않았습니다. 여기서는 ``\\``로 시작하는 것을 인식하지 않았기 때문입니다. 따옴표 없는 경로의 마지막 구성 요소 뒤에는 구분자가 없어 공백이 경로 내부인지 뒤따르는 텍스트인지 입증할 수 없습니다. 따라서 숫자, 대문자로 시작하는 단어, 파일 이름처럼 이름 형태인 단어만 마지막 구성 요소에 이어 붙입니다. ``\\LAB-NAS\screens\plate 1``는 전체가 바뀌지만 ``opening /mnt/data/x.tif failed``의 ``failed``는 남습니다. 마지막 구성 요소를 끝내는 소문자 단어도 남을 수 있습니다. 따옴표로 묶인 경로는 전체를 취하며, 제목과 ``repr``로 표현된 모든 설정 값은 따옴표로 묶입니다.

records.context: A slash straight after ``<`` starts a closing tag, not a path. The report's collapsible sections end in ``</summary>`` and ``</details>``, and issue #121 was filed with both turned into ``<<PATH>``, so every section after the first one stayed open.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#3
records.source: A slash straight after ``<`` starts a closing tag, not a path. The report's collapsible sections end in ``</summary>`` and ``</details>``, and issue #121 was filed with both turned into ``<<PATH>``, so every section after the first one stayed open.
records.translation: ``<`` 바로 뒤의 슬래시는 경로가 아니라 닫는 태그의 시작입니다. 보고서의 접을 수 있는 섹션은 ``</summary>`` 와 ``</details>`` 로 끝나는데, 이슈 #121 은 둘 다 ``<<PATH>`` 로 바뀐 채 제출되어 첫 번째 이후의 모든 섹션이 열린 채로 남았습니다.

records.context: a report title or body, already through :func:`sanitize_path`.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#4
records.source: a report title or body, already through :func:`sanitize_path`.
records.translation: 보고서 제목 또는 본문이며, 이미 :func:`sanitize_path` 를 거친 것입니다.

records.context: the same text with path-shaped tokens replaced by ``<PATH>``.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.strip_report_paths#5
records.source: the same text with path-shaped tokens replaced by ``<PATH>``.
records.translation: 경로 모양의 토큰을 ``<PATH>`` 로 바꾼 같은 텍스트입니다.

records.context: Submit an approved payload through the API, with browser-form fallback.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.submit_report#0
records.source: Submit an approved payload through the API, with browser-form fallback.
records.translation: 승인된 페이로드를 API로 제출하고, 실패 시 브라우저 양식을 대체 경로로 사용합니다.

records.context: The approved payload with ``title`` and ``body`` structured-data names, plus ``fingerprint`` for the duplicate search when a token is available. Callers prepare any required redaction before calling. If API posting does not yield a URL, construct a pre-filled issue URL and request that the browser open it. This helper does not display an approval preview or apply :func:`public_report`.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.submit_report#1
records.source: The approved payload with ``title`` and ``body`` keys, plus ``fingerprint`` for the duplicate search when a token is available. Callers prepare any required redaction before calling. If API posting does not yield a URL, construct a pre-filled issue URL and request that the browser open it. This helper does not display an approval preview or apply :func:`public_report`.
records.translation: 승인된 페이로드로, ``title``과 ``body`` 키 및 토큰이 있을 때 중복 검색에 사용하는 ``fingerprint``를 포함합니다. 호출자는 호출 전에 필요한 정보 가림 처리를 준비합니다. API 제출에서 URL을 얻지 못하면 미리 채워진 이슈 URL을 만들고 브라우저에 열기를 요청합니다. 이 보조 함수는 승인용 미리 보기를 표시하거나 :func:`public_report`를 적용하지 않습니다.

records.context: The API result URL, the pre-filled ``issues/new`` URL, or a transport refusal message. Returning the browser-form URL does not mean the browser accepted it or an issue was filed. Errors constructing that fallback URL can propagate.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.submit_report#2
records.source: The API result URL, the pre-filled ``issues/new`` URL, or a transport refusal message. Returning the browser-form URL does not mean the browser accepted it or an issue was filed. Errors constructing that fallback URL can propagate.
records.translation: API 결과 URL, 미리 채워진 ``issues/new`` URL 또는 전송 거부 메시지입니다. 브라우저 양식 URL을 반환했다고 해서 브라우저가 이를 받아들였거나 이슈가 등록되었다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 대체 URL을 만드는 과정의 오류는 호출자에게 전파될 수 있습니다.

records.context: Read a pending restart record and attempt to remove its file.
records.label: spacr.restart_state.take#0
records.source: Read a pending restart record and attempt to remove its file.
records.translation: 대기 중인 재시작 기록을 읽고 해당 파일의 삭제를 시도합니다.

records.context: Attempt to remove the saved file after reading it, including when no valid key-value mapping was read. A failed removal does not prevent a key-value mapping from being returned. A key-value mapping is rejected as expired only when its parseable ``saved`` timestamp is older than :data:`MAX_AGE_SECONDS`; missing or invalid timestamps are not treated as expired.
records.label: spacr.restart_state.take#1
records.source: Attempt to remove the saved file after reading it, including when no valid dictionary was read. A failed removal does not prevent a dictionary from being returned. A dictionary is rejected as expired only when its parseable ``saved`` timestamp is older than :data:`MAX_AGE_SECONDS`; missing or invalid timestamps are not treated as expired.
records.translation: 저장된 파일을 읽은 뒤 삭제를 시도하며, 유효한 딕셔너리를 읽지 못한 경우에도 삭제를 시도합니다. 삭제에 실패해도 딕셔너리를 반환할 수 있습니다. 딕셔너리는 해석 가능한 ``saved`` 타임스탬프의 경과 시간이 :data:`MAX_AGE_SECONDS`보다 클 때만 만료된 것으로 거부됩니다. 누락되었거나 유효하지 않은 타임스탬프는 만료된 것으로 처리하지 않습니다.

records.context: key-value mapping or None A readable saved key-value mapping not known to be expired, or ``None`` if no such key-value mapping is available.
records.label: spacr.restart_state.take#3
records.source: dict or None A readable saved dictionary not known to be expired, or ``None`` if no such dictionary is available.
records.translation: dict 또는 None 읽을 수 있는 저장된 딕셔너리 중 만료되었다고 확인되지 않은 딕셔너리입니다. 해당 딕셔너리가 없으면 ``None``입니다.

records.context: Bucketed by *consequence*, not by structured-data name, following the same reasoning as :func:`spacr.run_journal.diff_runs`: a flat key-value mapping diff of two runs is mostly schema noise, and the one change that matters drowns in it.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#1
records.source: Bucketed by *consequence*, not by key, following the same reasoning as :func:`spacr.run_journal.diff_runs`: a flat dict diff of two runs is mostly schema noise, and the one change that matters drowns in it.
records.translation: 키가 아니라 *결과*에 따라 분류하며 :func:`spacr.run_journal.diff_runs`와 같은 논리를 따릅니다. 두 실행의 딕셔너리를 단순히 비교하면 대부분 스키마 차이만 드러나고, 중요한 변경은 그 속에 묻힙니다.

records.context: material differences — these block the resume.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#2
records.source: material differences — these block the resume.
records.translation: 중대한 차이이며, 재개를 차단합니다.

records.context: differences for shared keys classified as cosmetic by the supplied key set.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#3
records.source: differences for shared keys classified as cosmetic by the supplied key set.
records.translation: 양쪽에 공통으로 있는 키 중 제공된 키 집합에 따라 외형적 차이로 분류된 차이입니다.

records.context: package/platform differences. Reported, never blocking.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#4
records.source: package/platform differences. Reported, never blocking.
records.translation: 패키지/플랫폼 차이입니다. 보고되지만 재개를 차단하지 않습니다.

records.context: keys the old run had and this one does not.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#5
records.source: keys the old run had and this one does not.
records.translation: 이전 실행에는 있었지만 현재 실행에는 없는 키입니다.

records.context: structured-data names present only in the current settings that are classified as cosmetic or environmental, or whose values normalize to ``None`` or ``()``.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#6
records.source: keys present only in the current settings that are classified as cosmetic or environmental, or whose values normalize to ``None`` or ``()``.
records.translation: 현재 설정에만 있는 키 중 외형적 또는 환경 관련으로 분류되거나, 값이 ``None`` 또는 ``()``로 정규화되는 키입니다.

records.context: count of keys that agree.
records.label: spacr.resume.SettingsComparison#7
records.source: count of keys that agree.
records.translation: 값이 일치하는 키의 수입니다.

records.context: Throw :class:`ResumeRefused` when the settings comparison reports material changes.
records.label: spacr.resume.check_settings_compatible#0
records.source: Raise :class:`ResumeRefused` when the settings comparison reports material changes.
records.translation: 설정 비교에서 중대한 변경이 보고되면 :class:`ResumeRefused`를 발생시킵니다.

records.context: Call :func:`compare_settings` with ``recorded``, ``current`` and ``cosmetic``. Return the comparison when its ``blocks_resume`` value is false; otherwise raise :class:`ResumeRefused` naming the reported material changes. Environment differences, cosmetic differences and non-blocking schema differences do not trigger this refusal.
records.label: spacr.resume.check_settings_compatible#1
records.source: Call :func:`compare_settings` with ``recorded``, ``current`` and ``cosmetic``. Return the comparison when its ``blocks_resume`` value is false; otherwise raise :class:`ResumeRefused` naming the reported material changes. Environment differences, cosmetic differences and non-blocking schema differences do not trigger this refusal.
records.translation: :func:`compare_settings`에 ``recorded``, ``current``, ``cosmetic``을 전달하여 호출합니다. 비교 결과의 ``blocks_resume`` 값이 거짓이면 비교 결과를 반환하고, 그렇지 않으면 보고된 중대한 변경을 명시하는 :class:`ResumeRefused`를 발생시킵니다. 환경 차이, 외형적 차이, 재개를 차단하지 않는 스키마 차이는 이 거부를 일으키지 않습니다.

records.context: settings read back from the previous processing session.
records.label: spacr.resume.check_settings_compatible#2
records.source: settings read back from the previous run.
records.translation: 이전 실행에서 다시 읽어 온 설정입니다.

records.context: the settings this processing session would use.
records.label: spacr.resume.check_settings_compatible#3
records.source: the settings this run would use.
records.translation: 이번 실행에서 사용할 설정입니다.

records.context: where ``recorded`` came from, quoted in the error.
records.label: spacr.resume.check_settings_compatible#4
records.source: where ``recorded`` came from, quoted in the error.
records.translation: ``recorded``를 가져온 위치로, 오류 메시지에 인용됩니다.

records.source: For keys present in both mappings, values considered equal count toward ``same``. Otherwise, keys in ``ENV_SETTINGS`` are recorded as environment differences, keys in ``cosmetic`` as cosmetic drift, and all others as material changes.
records.translation: 두 매핑에 모두 있는 키의 경우, 같다고 판단되는 값은 ``same``에 집계됩니다. 그렇지 않으면 ``ENV_SETTINGS``에 있는 키는 환경 차이로, ``cosmetic``에 있는 키는 외형적 차이로, 나머지는 모두 중대한 변경으로 기록됩니다.

records.context: Structured-data names present only in ``recorded`` do not block resume. A structured-data name present only in ``current`` is classified as material unless it is in ``cosmetic`` or ``ENV_SETTINGS``, or its value normalizes to ``None`` or ``()``. The non-blocking current-only structured-data names are returned in ``only_in_current``.
records.label: spacr.resume.compare_settings#2
records.source: Keys present only in ``recorded`` do not block resume. A key present only in ``current`` is classified as material unless it is in ``cosmetic`` or ``ENV_SETTINGS``, or its value normalizes to ``None`` or ``()``. The non-blocking current-only keys are returned in ``only_in_current``.
records.translation: ``recorded``에만 있는 키는 재개를 차단하지 않습니다. ``current``에만 있는 키는 ``cosmetic`` 또는 ``ENV_SETTINGS``에 포함되거나 값이 ``None`` 또는 ``()``로 정규화되는 경우를 제외하고 중대한 변경으로 분류됩니다. 현재 설정에만 있으며 재개를 차단하지 않는 키는 ``only_in_current``로 반환됩니다.
